fee_notes: Standard single-unit fee is $5,000 Initial Franchise Fee + $15,000 Initial Franchise Support Fee = $20,000 combined, both required at signing and non-refundable. During 2024 fiscal year, collected $0–$30,000. Non-Trad locations pay $5,000 IFF + $10,000 ISF = $15,000.
raw_excerpt: you must pay to us an initial franchise fee of $5,000 ("Initial Franchise Fee") and an initial franchise support fee of $15,000 ("Initial Support Fee") when you sign the Franchise Agreement. During the 2024 fiscal year, we collected Initial Franchise fees ranging from $0 to $30,000.
